description: WHEN TO CALL: to run a tool on another remote MCP server without connecting to it or loading its tool list. Pass server (id or short name), tool and arguments; returns that tool's result. Works for live servers that need no login; for others it answers needs_auth or not_callable with how to connect directly. Never send secrets in arguments. Free: 20 calls a day without a key, 100 with a free key; paid plans for more.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, matching its input schema.

server.description: The server id or short name (from find_tool or route_task).

tool.description: The tool's name on that server (or a full id 'server/tool').

name: call_remote_tool
